name: Scornful Superiority
body:
Your contemptuous fighting style humiliates and unnerves your foes.

Prerequisite(s): Evil alignment, panache class feature, menacing swordplay deed, Antagonize

Benefit(s): When you use the menacing swordplay deed or the Antagonize feat, you can accept a -2 penalty to AC until the end of your next turn. If you do so, you gain a +4 bonus on the skill check. If you confirm a critical hit against a creature you have intimidated with the Antagonize feat, you can intimidate it an additional time that day.

Special: You can use this feat in place of Precise Shot to qualify for Signature Strike Style, and in place of Improved Unarmed Strike to qualify for Diabolic Style. You can make the attacks of opportunity granted by Diabolic Style with any light or one-handed melee weapon with which you have Weapon Focus.
